parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Ulakwo (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 14.369 | 0.124 | 0.12415
2 | 15.965 | 8.25 | 9.665
3 | 4591.4 | 27.074 | 47.738
4 | 5101.5 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as A-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Ulakwo
Curve type: A-type
Aquifer depth: 9.665 m – 47.738 m
Recommendation: Target the resistive sand/sandstone unit (Layer 3, ~4591 Ω·m) between about 9.7 m and 47.7 m depth for the production borehole; ensure adequate casing and screen placement through the overlying low-resistivity clayey layer (0–9.665 m) to prevent contamination and borehole collapse.
